prior_entry.subject: fix(cdk/table): the CdkNoDataRow directive does not render in the OnPush strategy (#27687)
prior_entry.reason: The patch calls markForCheck on CdkTable when the no-data row is shown or hidden. MatLegacyTable extends CdkTable and does not reimplement that toggle. MatLegacyNoDataRow only sets the mat-no-data-row class. The CDK method was not copied into this package. Inherited via installed peer @angular/cdk@22.1.7 (advertised floor ^22.1.7); upstream SHA is an ancestor of v22.1.7.

analysis: The complete original patch has one runtime addition: markForCheck after the no-data visibility state changes. Four outlet constructor edits are formatting. The new upstream Angular test uses an OnPush child, a stable data-source input and an evaluated colspan binding. Earlier complete-renderer-method replay supplies an explicit markForCheck protocol and cannot prove actual Angular child checking. The owned table delegates rendering to public CdkTable; owned no-data configuration preserves original row/cell classes. A matching packed standalone regression is now mandatory but has not executed. Ancestry, a mark-call spy and a static row are insufficient for inheritance closure.
required_execution: Actual extracted-artifact Angular TestBed case on this line; native/browser/compiler floors remain separate.
